title: MathViz ProblemSpec v1 (P5.0, frozen)
description: The LLM-facing INPUT contract, layered BEFORE Math IR (P5 restructure). A ProblemSpec expresses SOURCE semantics only: the problem's world (entities), its givens (source facts with problem-text provenance), and WHAT is asked (goals referencing registry capabilities). It is structurally INCAPABLE of carrying answers: goals admit exactly {goalId, capabilityId, inputs}; answer-shaped layers (derived_facts, events, runtime_values, assertions, capabilities, scene) are not properties of this object at all. A deterministic compiler (packages/spec) turns a valid ProblemSpec into a Math IR v1 document whose derived facts are computed by the domain solvers, never asserted by the producer. The LLM (P5.1) parses NL -> ProblemSpec and MUST NOT generate Math IR directly.

statement.description: Original problem text. Source-fact provenance spans resolve against this string; goals do not reference it.

SourceEntity.description: Same structural shape as a Math IR entity, but only SOURCE entities belong here: no dynamic/derived entity kinds (they are compiler outputs), no claim/drawing-motivated kinds.

SpecSourceFact.description: Stricter than Math IR source facts: provenance (problem_text + span) is REQUIRED by the schema itself, and values must be ExactNumber objects — a parser cannot smuggle a free-form answer payload.

capabilityId.description: Registry capability that answers this goal. Must be family 'solver' or 'event' (checked by the semantic validator), so presentation-only capabilities cannot pose as goals.

inputs.description: What the goal is asked ABOUT — references to source entities/facts. additionalProperties:false on Goal means NO value/answer/expectation field can exist here at all.

Goal.description: A question, never an answer. FROZEN: the only three keys are goalId, capabilityId, inputs.
